description:
Overview

The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer is responsible for interpreting internal or external business issues and recommending best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex Installation Analysis-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in Installation Analysis. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in Installation Analysis as well as broad knowledge of the Installation Analysis discipline within the Engineering function.

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master’s is a preference)
  • 15-20 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Detailed knowledge of design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the theory, content, and application of standards, codes, and guidelines as applicable Knowledgeable in project coordination and execution skills
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

Responsibilities

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed analyses and design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Apply in-depth skills and broad knowledge of the business to address complex problems and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and procedures
  • Manage own time to meet objectives and (as Lead Engineer) forecast and plan resource requirements
  • Communicate and explain difficult concepts and persuade others to adopt a point of view
  • When acting as Lead Engineer, in addition:
    • Direct an Engineering team as a Lead Engineer
    • Lead the Discipline engineering design of the assigned work area and complete it within the planned schedule and budget, in accordance with standards, MDR, and project-specific procedures and to a high professional standard
    • Plan, organize, and direct all aspects of Discipline execution on the assigned project including scope, deliverables, schedule, and all manpower resources - agree allocations with the Discipline Manager
    • Ensure interfaces and deliverables are clearly identified
    • Maintain responsibility for progress and productivity, identifying any required corrective action
    • Act as project representative for Discipline during meetings with the Project Team, Customer discipline lead, and relevant agencies such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.
  • Become fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address issues, interpreting contractual requirements as they relate to engineering execution
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for variation orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash-free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close coordination with other engineering disciplines, Planning, fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to Discipline Lead Engineer and Discipline Manager
  • Prepare estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and manhour estimates, identifying software requirements and any other project-specific requirements
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications
  • Participate in finalizing deliverable lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Review project schedule and fabrication schedule in relation to construction sequence, milestones, and engineering scope
  • Attend project kickoff and review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve design reports and procedures
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • Assist procurement personnel in procuring discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with Customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing, reviewing, and (as Lead Engineer) approving requisitions, evaluating technical quotations, and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve vendor and subcontractor submittals, checking for compliance with project specifications and providing comments as necessary
  • Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve design verification through single-discipline check /inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Discipline Manager and Project Management Team apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Check final subcontractor and vendor data manuals to ensure that all requested data has been received and approved
  • Present issues and problems to Customers in a timely manner and assist the Lead Engineer in negotiating resolution in accordance with project and company requirements
  • Perform (as required) Technical Quality Audit reviews in accordance with MDR Global Procedures
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Supervise and guide assigned engineers and coordinate with Lead Designers for Discipline engineering and design deliverables

description:
Overview

A L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, a L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a “criar a beleza que move o mundo”; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.

Missão

A posição de Coordenador(a) de Data & Analytics para divisão L’Oréal Grande Público desempenhará um papel fundamental na transformação de dados brutos em insights acionáveis, apoiando a tomada de decisões estratégicas em várias funções. Esta posição será responsável por todo o ciclo de vida dos dados dentro da divisão, desde a consolidação e análise de dados até o desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards intuitivos. O candidato ideal fará a ponte entre as capacidades técnicas de dados e as necessidades de negócios, atuando como um parceiro confiável para liberar todo o potencial de nossos ativos de dados.

Vaga Corporate com dedicação exclusiva para a divisão L’Oréal Grande Público.

Principais Atividades

  • Análise de Dados para Geração de Insights: realizar análises de dados abrangentes, desde solicitações ad-hoc simples até investigações de alta complexidade, para identificar tendências, padrões e insights acionáveis relevantes para os objetivos de negócios da DPGP.
  • Apoiar projetos analíticos complexos, coletando requisitos, preparando dados e contribuindo para a modelagem analítica sob orientação sênior.
  • Traduzir descobertas analíticas complexas em outputs claros, concisos e acionáveis para as partes interessadas do negócio.
  • Desenvolvimento e Manutenção de Dashboards: projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards interativos (ex: usando Power BI) para visualizar Indicadores-Chave de Desempenho (KPIs) e métricas operacionais para a divisão.
  • Garantir a precisão, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados em todas as ferramentas e dashboards de relatórios.
  • Colaborar com o Data Stewards para garantir a adesão às políticas de governança de dados e padrões de qualidade de dados.
  • Suporte à Gestão e Governança de Dados: auxiliar na garantia da qualidade, integridade e acessibilidade dos dados divisionais, apoiando os esforços de limpeza e validação de dados.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a Equipe Central de Dados e os Data Stewards das divisões para implementar e monitorar estruturas de governança de dados.
  • Parceria e Comunicação com Stakeholders: atuar como ponto de contato principal para solicitações de dados e análises dentro da divisão DPGP, compreendendo os desafios de negócios e traduzindo-os em requisitos de dados.
  • Comunicar os insights de dados de forma eficaz para diversas audiências, incluindo stakeholders não técnicos, por meio de apresentações envolventes e storytelling visual.
  • Otimização de Processos e Automação: identificar oportunidades para otimizar processos de dados, automatizar relatórios e aprimorar as capacidades de tomada de decisão baseadas em dados dentro da divisão.
  • Contribuir para a definição e aderência aos SLAs para análise de dados e entrega de dashboards.
  • Implementação de Projetos Globais e Regionais: participar ativamente e liderar a implementação local de projetos de dados globais e regionais.
  • Garantir a adoção local, ativação e curadoria contínua dos dados relacionados a essas iniciativas.
  • Conduzir o rollout bem-sucedido dos projetos, com foco em assegurar sua escalabilidade, rentabilidade e relevância local.

Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Experiência em análise de dados, business intelligence ou função analítica similar.
  • Proficiência em SQL, ETL, Python, LLM e IA para extração e manipulação de dados não estruturados.
  • Experiência em pelo menos uma ferramenta líder de Business Intelligence (ex: Power BI) para desenvolvimento de dashboards e visualização de dados.
  • Habilidades avançadas em Excel.
  • Sólida compreensão dos conceitos de data warehousing e princípios de modelagem de dados.
  • Habilidades analíticas, de resolução de problemas e de pensamento crítico.
  • Habilidades de comunicação e interpessoais, com a capacidade de explicar conceitos complexos e técnicos de forma clara.
  • Atitude proativa, orientada a detalhes e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em um ambiente dinâmico.

  • Ambiente inclusivo e diverso;
  • Cultura voltada para pessoas, pessoas e pessoas!

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description:
Overview

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence. The Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience will be building and shaping our product for Private Equity clients, collaborating with business and engineering teams across domains including Cap Table Management and Fund administration.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. You will be one of the key contributors improving operational efficiency, building new features, and leveraging standardized solutions in a challenging product area.

The Team You'll Work With

The Unified Experience for PE team at Carta helps private equity firms easily see and manage their portfolio companies by creating connected and user-friendly tools. The team’s core focus is to create a unified experience for investors — including detailed views for PE-backed LLCs.

Some of the key problem areas you will be working on:

  • Fragmented experience - The platform lacks unified dashboards for all investment entities, especially PE-backed LLCs, making portfolio overviews difficult.
  • Missing Valuations and Insights - Key information (valuations, holdings, financials, KPIs) is not easily accessible for PE-backed LLCs and FA issuers, limiting transparency.
  • Cumbersome Entry to Key Products - No streamlined way to access essential tools (e.g., valuations, data monitoring) from portfolio views.
  • Disconnected Platform Workflows - Data and workflows across investments, valuation, and reporting aren’t well integrated—impacting product launches and analytics.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to design and deliver enterprise-grade features for the Unified Experience for PE.
  • Build and shape front-end and/or full-stack solutions using ReactJS, TypeScript, and related tooling.
  • Champion scalable architectures, SOA/microservices concepts, and data-driven approaches to improve user experience for Private Equity clients.
  • Engage with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing to deliver customer value and refine requirements.

About You

  • You deeply care about your users and are relentless in your pursuit to build enterprise-grade applications. You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively and can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally:
  • 5+ years of frontend or full-stack engineering experience.
  • Experience in architecting complex SaaS products with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and microservices.
  • Passion for elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, TypeScript, React Queries, Storybook, Amplitude, Ink).
  • Ability to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing.
  • Interest in AI/ML technologies and how they can improve product experiences.
  • A desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to own your work end-to-end.
  • Willingness to move fast while building for the future.

Disclosures

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.

Missão

A posição de Coordenador(a) de Data & Analytics para divisão L’Oréal Grande Público desempenhará um papel fundamental na transformação de dados brutos em insights acionáveis, apoiando a tomada de decisões estratégicas em várias funções. Esta posição será responsável por todo o ciclo de vida dos dados dentro da divisão, desde a consolidação e análise de dados até o desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards intuitivos. Principais Atividades

  • Análise de Dados para Geração de Insights: Realizar análises de dados abrangentes, desde solicitações ad-hoc simples até investigações de alta complexidade, para identificar tendências, padrões e insights acionáveis relevantes para os objetivos de negócios da DPGP.
  • Desenvolvimento e Manutenção de Dashboards: Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards interativos (ex: usando Power BI) para visualizar Indicadores-Chave de Desempenho (KPIs) e métricas operacionais para a divisão. Garantir a precisão, consistência e confiabilidade dos dados em todas as ferramentas e dashboards de relatórios.
  • Suporte à Gestão e Governança de Dados: Auxiliar na garantia da qualidade, integridade e acessibilidade dos dados divisionais, apoiando os esforços de limpeza e validação de dados. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a Equipe Central de Dados e os Data Stewards das divisões para implementar e monitorar estruturas de governança de dados.
  • Parceria e Comunicação com Stakeholders: Atuar como ponto de contato principal para solicitações de dados e análises dentro da divisão DPGP, compreendendo os desafios de negócios e traduzindo-os em requisitos de dados. Comunicar os insights de dados de forma eficaz para diversas audiências, incluindo stakeholders não técnicos, por meio de apresentações envolventes e storytelling visual.

  • Implementação de Projetos Globais e Regionais: Participar ativamente e liderar a implementação local de projetos de dados globais e regionais. Garantir a adoção local, ativação e curadoria contínua dos dados relacionados a essas iniciativas. Conduzir o rollout bem-sucedido dos projetos, com foco em assegurar sua escalabilidade, rentabilidade e relevância local.

  • Experiência em análise de dados, business intelligence ou função analítica similar.

  • Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Nossas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, estendendo-se para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos de enfermagem e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior em Enfermagem completo.
  • Pós-Graduação completa em Auditoria em Saúde, Gestão Hospitalar, Saúde Pública ou áreas afins ou áreas correlatas.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiencia mínima de 06 (seis) meses na função.

Additional information

Horário: 09:00 - 15:00

description:
About Web Summit

How did Web Summit become, in the words of Forbes, the best tech conference on the planet? Meaningful connections. Our tech events are unmissable because we make it easier for the right people to meet and connect. Everyone at Web Summit works towards this goal. And we’re just getting started. We’re always looking to build on the impact we have already made at Web Summit. In the coming years we’ll take Web Summit to new markets, promoting global connectivity, highlighting important issues and connecting global leaders – all while making a positive impact on the environment and communities we encounter. To build a better company, we have to better ourselves. We do that by finding the most ambitious people to work with us.

The role

We’re looking for a Creative Producer to join our growing Content Team for Web Summit Rio . You’ll be responsible for curating, shaping, and delivering high-calibre on-stage content. From speaker booking to on-site production, this is a fast-paced, high-impact role where editorial meets execution.

What you will do

  • Industry Research: Track trends, identify leading voices, and stay ahead of emerging startups and technologies across relevant industries.
  • Speaker Booking: Secure high-profile and A-list speakers, especially for our Centre Stage. You’ll lead outreach, negotiations, and coordination with speakers and their teams.
  • Editorial Ownership: Shape the narrative of our stages. Work with speakers to define compelling topics, formats, and titles. Write talk descriptions, moderator briefs, and technical scripts.
  • Live Production: Manage speaker logistics and live rehearsals. Ensure all assets are prepped and stages run smoothly on-site, collaborating with technical and production teams.
  • Platform & Data Management: Maintain accurate records using our internal platforms and tools. Attention to detail and flawless admin are essential to your success.
  • Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships with speakers, companies, and stakeholders before, during, and after the event.
  • Internal Expertise: Be a source of insight and strategic advice for internal teams. You’ll act as the go-to expert for your speaker tracks and industries.

Skills and abilities we\'re looking for

  • You’re consistently booking high-quality, relevant speakers for Centre Stage and beyond.
  • You aim to confirm at least 4 A-list speakers per year across your content verticals.
  • You stay ahead of industry shifts and consistently maintain a strong research pipeline with timely, strategic outreach.
  • You communicate clearly and proactively with your manager, particularly around pipeline challenges.
  • You demonstrate strong editorial judgment , creating engaging formats and talk titles that resonate with our global audience.
  • You are a reliable team player who collaborates effectively across departments.
  • Your admin and data tracking are consistently up-to-date and accurate, supporting seamless internal operations.

Who you are

  • Ideally, 2–4 years of experience in production, content, editorial, or events (or adjacent industries)
  • Strong interest in tech, innovation, entrepreneurship, or media
  • Confident communicator with experience engaging high-profile individuals and companies
  • Exceptional organisational and writing skills
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and spoken)
  • Experience with tools like CRMs, Google Suite, and other productivity platforms is a plus

Benefits and perks

  • Hybrid-working model open to all employees.
  • Fully subsidised healthcare, dental, employee assistance programme (EAP) and more.
  • Pension contribution up to 6% (Irish based only).
  • A dedicated in-house L&D department, with access to workshops, online learning and resources to help you excel in your career development.
  • Company laptop, generous annual leave and flexible working arrangements.
  • Our very own Tramway Team, which drives community and morale-boosting events for employees to participate in.
  • Annual company get-togethers, charity days, and monthly wellbeing talks.
  • Wellness subsidy issued to all employees of €1000 per year

At Web Summit, we embrace diversity and inclusion. We want talent from all walks of life to help us on our journey to digitise the conference sector. Hiring decisions are made purely on experience, skills and the needs of the business.

title: LACTARISTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Preparar fórmulas de composições lácteas, hídricas e dietas enterais a serem utilizadas nas diversas clínicas do Hospital, bem como efetuar a higienização de embalagens, bicos, mamadeiras e outros.

Requirements and skills

Ensino Médio completo

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Lactarista

Additional information

Local: Santa Cruz - RJ

Escala: 12 horas de trabalho x 36 horas de descanso

Horário: 07:00 - 19:00 e/ou 19:00 - 07:00 (folguista)

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Training Site Infrastructure Manager role at FIFA Women's World Cup

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Training Site Infrastructure Manager reports to the FWWC27 Head of Infrastructure and Technical Services and FIFA Training Sites Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Tournament Infrastructure team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders. The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA's exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

This position plays a pivotal role in the planning, development, and delivery of infrastructure at FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 training sites across Brazil. Working alongside the FIFA Training Site Manager and in coordination with Team Services, Technical Services, Pitch Management, Venue Design, Dressing & Signage, Media Operations, Partnerships and external stakeholders (Training Site Authorities and Football Clubs), the role is responsible for ensuring all training sites are operationally ready and compliant with FIFA’s requirements and standards.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in architectural and interior design, technical project management, stakeholder coordination, and large-scale international event delivery. As demonstrated through global events such as FIFA World Cups and Olympic Games. They will manage the implementation of training site upgrades, including renovations, overlays, and delivery of essential infrastructure, with a focus on strategic planning, design integration, and resource optimization.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the design and infrastructure delivery strategy for all FWWC2027 training sites, incorporating best practices in venue planning, design management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinate the implementation of renovations and upgrades, overseeing construction quality, progress, and alignment with FIFA’s requirements and standards.
  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of overlay and technical service delivery, including scope definition, scheduling, procurement, installation, and handover.
  • Engage with Training Site Authorities, contractors, and internal teams to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery.
  • Implement project controls for budgeting, reporting, and risk mitigation.
  • Ensure sustainability, cultural alignment, and aesthetic quality across all training site environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Pitch Management, Cleaning & Waste, Venue Design, and Dressing & Signage to ensure cohesive delivery.

YOUR PROFILE

  • 10+ years of experience in architectural design, project management, and delivery of international sporting event infrastructure.
  • Proven track record in managing venue delivery and readiness, overlay operations, or major venue infrastructure for events like FIFA World Cup or Olympics.
  • Strong technical expertise in space planning, stakeholder communication, and procurement processes.
  • Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Project Management, Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: College Research Administration Manager
description:
Overview

Howard University seeks a dynamic and skilled College Research Administration Manager to oversee research administration activities within assigned colleges. This hybrid reporting role is pivotal to advancing the university’s R1 research mission by ensuring compliance, enhancing research productivity, and maintaining efficient workflows. The manager will handle pre- and post-award responsibilities, working collaboratively with the Office of Research, college leadership, Principal Investigators (PIs), and other stakeholders.

Nature And Scope

Serve as the primary point of contact for all assigned departments within the college for pre-award and post-award support. This position reports to the Office of Research for strategic oversight, training, and compliance, with a dotted-line relationship to the Associate Dean for Research to align daily priorities with college needs. The incumbent bridges central oversight and college-specific needs to ensure the success of research activities across the institution. External contacts include representatives from the federal government, other colleges and universities, professional associations, consultants, vendors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

Pre-Award Management

  • Guide PIs in preparing and submitting grant proposals, including budgets, narratives, and compliance documentation.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for grant submissions to central research offices and funding agencies.
  • Review and approve proposals for adherence to university, federal, and sponsor guidelines.

Post-Award Management

  • Oversee grant account setups, cost distributions, and personnel appointments on awarded projects.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, local, and university policies regarding allowable costs, effort reporting, and project amendments.
  • Monitor project budgets and expenditures, providing timely financial reports and projections.

Compliance and Reporting

  • Facilitate the preparation and submission of internal and external reports, including progress, compliance, and financial reports.
  • Collaborate with university compliance offices to address regulatory requirements and audit findings.

Training and Development

  • Conduct training sessions for PIs, departmental staff, and other stakeholders on research administration policies and systems.
  • Participate in university-wide discussions on process improvement and best practices in research administration.

Collaboration and Oversight

  • Work with the Associate Dean for Research to align daily operations with college priorities.
  • Maintain active collaboration with the Office of Research to ensure consistent training, compliance, and professional development across colleges.
  • Act as a resource for faculty and staff in navigating research administration challenges.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with a high degree of accuracy and organization; strong time management and attention to detail; ability to coordinate multiple activities and reprioritize as needed.
  • Effective communication with investigators and internal and external stakeholders; ability to interpret and convey technical contract language and liaise with granting agencies, University administration, and principal investigators.

Minimum Requirements

  • BA, BBA, or BS (foreign equivalent or higher) in Business, Finance, Accounting, or related fields and 5 years of professional experience in research administration.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Advanced knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations governing sponsored research, including Uniform Guidance and FAR clauses.
  • Excellent communication skills, including conveying complex concepts to non-specialist audiences.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in research administration systems (e.g., Cayuse, Workday).

Note: This position description does not imply exclusive standards and the university reserves the right to revise this description. This description is not a contract of employment.

Expected Pay Range: $90,909 - $100,000

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience

Company overview: Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through software for venture capital, private equity and private credit. Carta’s platform supports 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries and provides tools to build, invest, and scale with confidence. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with solutions designed to enhance the impact of fund CFOs. Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure and creating an end-to-end ERP platform for private markets.

For more information about offices and culture, visit the Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve

As a Senior Engineer, you will help build and shape our product for Private Equity clients. You will contribute to improving operational efficiency, building new features, and leveraging standardized solutions. You will collaborate with business and engineering teams across domains including Cap Table Management, Fund admins, and related areas.

The Team You'll Work With

The Unified Experience for PE team creates a unified, user-friendly experience for investors, including detailed views for PE-backed LLCs.

Key problem areas:

  • Fragmented experience: lack of unified dashboards for all investment entities, especially PE-backed LLCs, hindering portfolio overviews.
  • Missing valuations and insights: valuations, holdings, financials, and KPIs are not easily accessible for PE-backed LLCs and FA issuers.
  • Cumbersome entry to key products: no streamlined access to essential tools from portfolio views.
  • Disconnected platform workflows: data and workflows across investments, valuation, and reporting are not well integrated, impacting product launches and analytics.

About You

You care deeply about users and build enterprise-grade applications. You work well acrossSolver and Tech Lead archetypes and can transition between hands-on work and leadership. You should meet the following expectations:

  • You have 5+ years of frontend or full-stack engineering experience.
  • You have experience architecting complex SaaS products with SOA and microservices.
  • You are passionate about elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Typescript, React Queries, Storybook, Amplitude, Ink).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing.
  • You have an interest in AI/ML technologies and applying them to improve product experiences.
  • You aspire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You value communication as a strength and want to own your work end-to-end.
  • You are able to move fast while recognizing when to build for the future.

  • For information on data privacy policies, see Privacy, CA Candidate Privacy, and Brazil Transparency Report.

title: Manager/Specialist - Procurement Strategy (A&M Infra)
description:
Sobre a Alvarez & Marsal

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) é uma consultoria global com mais de 10.000 profissionais empreendedores, orientados para a ação e resultados, em mais de 40 países. Adotamos uma abordagem prática para resolver os problemas de nossos clientes e ajudá-los a atingir seu pleno potencial. Nossa cultura celebra pensadores independentes e realizadores que impactam positivamente nossos clientes e moldam nossa indústria. O ambiente colaborativo e o trabalho envolvente—guiados pelos valores centrais da A&M de Integridade, Qualidade, Objetividade, Diversão, Recompensa Pessoal e Diversidade Inclusiva—são as razões pelas quais nossos colaboradores adoram trabalhar na A&M.

A Equipe

A A&M Infra se dedica a todos os aspectos do ciclo de vida de projetos de capital intensivo, incluindo grandes empreendimentos nas áreas de logística, mineração, energia e O&G. Nossa atuação abrange desde a estruturação de projetos e processos de M&A relacionados a ativos de infraestrutura até todas as etapas de desenvolvimento e implementação, além da gestão dos ativos.

Como você irá contribuir

  • Liderar a execução de frentes de trabalho com propriedade, identificando iniciativas de melhoria, desempenhando papel ativo em todos os aspectos de envolvimento com o cliente;
  • Liderar reuniões e apresentações junto ao nível gerencial e executivo do cliente e da A&M, transmitindo segurança e domínio dos temas abordados;
  • Responder prontamente às demandas do projeto e antecipar ações críticas para o sucesso das iniciativas;
  • Atuação em diversos projetos e trabalho com vários colegas e clientes em uma variedade de setores e áreas funcionais;
  • Viabilizar articulações efetivas entre lideranças, conquistando alinhamentos e produzindo resultados que atendem aos interesses dos envolvidos;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento da prática apoiando o desenvolvimento de produto e/ou indústria;
  • Desenvolver a conta que estiver atuando, identificando oportunidades e trabalhando em conjunto com a liderança para transformar em negócios;
  • Ser elo de conexão entre staff e liderança para disseminação de cultura e gestão de questões;
  • Coordenar e garantir adequações às questões administrativas (programação, planilha de vendas, collections, etc.).

Qualificações

  • Graduação completa;
  • Experiência comprovada em gerenciamento de projetos complexos em ambiente multicultural e corporativo nos setores de mineração e Óleo & Gás, seja em consultorias ou indústrias;
  • Pós-graduação em gestão de projetos e/ou administração ou finanças será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento robusto dos produtos de I&CP;
  • Ao menos uma certificação em gestão de projetos de entidades preconizadas (ex: AACE, PMI, etc);
  • Habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral;
  • Disponibilidade para viajar;
  • Inglês avançado.

Sua jornada na A&M

Reconhecemos que nossos colaboradores são a força motriz por trás do nosso sucesso, e é por isso que priorizamos uma experiência que favorece o desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal único de cada pessoa. Nosso robusto processo de desenvolvimento de desempenho promove o aprendizado contínuo, recompensa suas contribuições e cultiva uma cultura de meritocracia. Com treinamentos de alta qualidade e oportunidades de aprendizado prático, você pode adquirir novas habilidades e avançar em sua carreira.

Priorizamos o seu bem-estar, oferecendo benefícios e recursos para apoiar sua jornada pessoal. Nossos colaboradores destacam constantemente as oportunidades de crescimento, nossa cultura empreendedora única e a diversão que vivenciamos juntos como os aspectos favoritos de trabalhar na A&M. As possibilidades são infinitas para profissionais de alto desempenho e paixão.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Diversidade Inclusiva significa que abraçamos a diversidade e promovemos a inclusão, incentivando todos a trazerem seu eu completo para o trabalho a cada dia. Isso permeia a maneira como recrutamos, desenvolvemos os colaboradores, conduzimos os negócios, apoiamos os clientes e fazemos parcerias com fornecedores. É a forma A&M de ser.

Empregador de Oportunidades Iguais

Job description

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Main responsibilities

  • Atuar como ponto focal entre o ativo e áreas da Diretoria de Operação onshore para qualquer assunto do sistema de gestão da empresa;
  • Suportar o tratamento de não conformidades regulatórias advindas de auditorias ANP, Classe, Marinha e auditorias internas junto aos especialistas de cada disciplina com o adequado acompanhamento de planos de ações, execução de ações no prazo e replanejamentos;

  • Acompanhar e suportar auditorias internas/externas nos ativos.
  • Ser referência no escritório quanto ao conhecimento de Sistemas de Gestão, Regulamentos ANP SGSO, SGIP, SGSS, Certificações ISOs suportando as áreas do ativo no cumprimento das rotinas em conformidade com a regulação vigente;
  • Elaborar planos de ação para tratamento dos desvios e incorporação aos procedimentos das lições aprendidas;
  • Mapear, padronizar, otimizar e manter atualizados os processos, normas e procedimentos do PRIO Way sob sua responsabilidade como facilitador;
  • Gerir os indicadores de processo e resultados estratégicos e táticos da empresa e suportar análises críticas;
  • Suportar a execução das rotinas e reuniões do escritório, garantindo padronização e ações a serem acompanhadas.

Requirements and skills

Formação acadêmica;

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia.

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória;

  • Experiência e conhecimento em Metodologias de Gestão (PDCA, SDCA, MASP, Desdobramento de Metas, Gerenciamento da Rotina do Dia a dia, Controle Estatístico de Processos, Padronização, etc);
  • Experiências com ferramentas da qualidade;
  • Experiência com tratamento de desvios e anomalias;
  • Experiência na gestão de projetos;
  • Experiência com Metodologias Ágeis (Scrum e Kanban) (Desejável);
  • Desejável conhecimento em desenvolvimento de softwares;
  • Conhecimento regulatório de sistemas de gestão de Óleo e Gás (ANP, IBAMA, etc).

Additional information

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

- Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Overview

Join to apply for the Software Developer role at TechnipFMC .

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

The Senior Software Developper calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT. You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test and deliver high quality, performant software products.
  • Work cross functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.
  • Develop test plans and test automation processes to increase automated functional tests.
  • Mentor team in development/test technologies, tools, and processes
  • Location: Tech Center - Ilha do Fundão - RJ

You Are Meant For This Job If

  • Requires a Bachelor of Science degree or related
  • Expertise in software engineering
  • Expert experience in C/C++, developing embedded software and systems software
  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby)
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (such as Docker), Kubernetes technologies (such K3S, Helm charts, Rancher), and IoT protocols (MQTT, REST API, Kafka)
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies such as AWS
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft MFC (Microsoft Foundation Class), WPF, Qt, or similar GUI framework
  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite)
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs for internal/external services
  • Exposure to the principals of Industrial Protocols, Platforms and APIs: OPC (DA & UA), Profibus, Profinet, Modbus (RTU, TCP, Enron), EtherIP, etc.
  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI)
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators)
  • Knowledge of web technologies, such as JavaScript, CSS, HTML5, XML, JSON, and/or Ajax
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards)
  • Exposure to developing in agile and Iterative Software development processes
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Full-time

Construindo sobre nosso passado. Prontos para o futuro

A Worley é uma empresa global de serviços profissionais composta por especialistas em energia, produtos químicos e recursos. Estabelecemos parcerias com clientes para entregar projetos e criar valor ao longo da vida de seus ativos. Procuramos um Coordenador(a) BIM para liderar a implementação, gestão e padronização de processos BIM em projetos de engenharia Onshore, assegurando conformidade com normas e integração com sistemas corporativos e dos clientes. O profissional será responsável por coordenar equipes multidisciplinares, gerir o fluxo de informações do projeto e garantir a aplicação das melhores práticas de Building Information Modeling para otimizar a qualidade e a eficiência na entrega dos empreendimentos.

  • Validar modelos digitais, assegurando consistência, integridade e qualidade das informações.
  • Promover integração entre plataformas BIM e sistemas corporativos (COMOS, AVEVA, Revit, Navisworks, entre outros).
  • Gerenciar revisões e controle de versões dos modelos digitais.
  • Treinar e dar suporte às equipes de projeto quanto às metodologias, ferramentas e fluxos BIM.
  • Apoiar clientes e stakeholders na interpretação e uso de informações geradas em ambiente BIM.
  • Participar ativamente na análise e proposição de melhorias nos processos digitais da companhia.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Engenharia, Arquitetura ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em coordenação de projetos BIM em indústrias de grande porte (óleo & gás, energia, mineração, infraestrutura).
  • Experiência com gestão de modelos multidisciplinares e detecção de interferências (Clash Detection).
  • Conhecimento de normas e padrões BIM nacionais e internacionais (incluindo ISO 19650).
  • Inglês técnico para leitura, escrita e comunicação com stakeholders.
  • Experiência com integração BIM em plataformas de gestão documental (Aconex, ProjectWise, SharePoint).
  • Conhecimento em programação visual (Dynamo, Grasshopper) e/ou linguagens de script aplicadas ao BIM.
  • Certificações em BIM Management.
  • Espanhol técnico.

Competências Comportamentais

Em FSO, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros.

#TAXFSO

Oportunidade disponível para atuação híbrida no escritório de São Paulo.

hybrid

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa Gerente de Tributos você será parte da área de Tax com foco na indústria financeira, atuando em consultoria tributária, auxiliando as empresas em projetos de compliance e consultoria em impostos diretos (CSLL e IRPJ) para bancos e seguradoras, assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Liderar equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos e exposições;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação do imposto diferido e respectivas projeções de acordo com as normas ASC 740 e IAS 12, bem como Tax Provision e reconciliação da alíquota efetiva;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação da apuração do imposto de renda e contribuição social seguindo as normas e legislações aplicáveis;
  • Realizar pesquisas e responder as consultas tributárias de clientes;
  • Atuar na revisão e preparação da ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal) e ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital);
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos de trabalho produtivos com os funcionários de clientes e avaliar sua satisfação;
  • Supervisionar o trabalho de campo diário, informar aos supervisores a situação do trabalho e gerenciar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, por meio da delegação efetiva de tarefas e fornecimento de orientação à equipe, fornecendo feedback e treinamento com relação ao desempenho;
  • Contribuir com ideias/opiniões para as equipes de impostos e ouvir/ser receptivo/a ao ponto de vista de outros membros da equipe;
  • Ter um entendimento das linhas de serviço da EY e buscar/incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços da empresa.

Por que você?

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;
  • Experiência consistente em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos, desenvolvendo estratégias de planejamento tributário alinhadas às necessidades globais de cada cliente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL – lucro real e lucro presumido) e na preparação e revisão de ECF e ECD;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Habilidade avançada na comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade no trabalho em equipe e liderança.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, compliance e planejamento Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para Pessoas Pretas e Mulheres do Brasil e, a 2a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

title: Access Center Nurse Coordinator
description:
Join to apply for the Access Center Nurse Coordinator role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Position Summary

Under the direction of the Sr. Director of Clinical Development, Department Chair, or assigned Director, the Nurse Coordinator is a vital clinical leader responsible for supporting high-quality patient care through a combination of direct clinical services (Resource Time ) and care coordination, communication, and planning activities (Coordination Time ). This role ensures safe, efficient, and patient-centered care while improving communication between patients, clinical staff, and providers. The Nurse Coordinator can be assigned to two of the following departments; Surgery, Medicine, Pediatrics, Orthopedics, Ophthalmology, Neurology, Psychiatry, Family Medicine, Dermatology, Women’s Health, FPP Administration or the Access Center.

Key Responsibilities

Resource Time – Clinical Care & Education

Time allocated for direct patient-facing care and in-clinic clinical responsibilities, including:

  • Attend and make recommendations for departmental huddles and delegation of clinical duties
  • Perform clinical skills, medication administration, and other direct care duties
  • Support daily clinic operations, triage, and patient flow
  • Educate patients and families on health conditions, medications, and follow-up instructions
  • Participate in and deliver in-service training and continuing education to staff
  • Ensure accurate documentation of all clinical activities in the EHR
  • Monitor for quality concerns during clinical care and escalate as needed
  • Support referral management, by triaging referrals against Schedule Advisor protocols
  • Support authorization team, by responding to peer-to-peer requests
  • Provide pre-surgery and pre-procedure patient education
  • Route patients to follow up appointments post discharge
  • Work with the Access Center Nursing team to implement red/yellow/green triage matrix

Coordination Time – Planning, Collaboration & Administrative Support

Time dedicated to activities that support quality and continuity of care, including:

  • Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings and provider collaboration sessions with Providers
  • Review labs, imaging, and patient messages/tasks to support timely follow-up
  • Coordinate patient care across departments during afternoon staffing huddle
  • Support tracking and follow-up of patients with chronic conditions, missed appointments, or abnormal results
  • Engage in quality improvement activities like QSI rounds, chart reviews, and safety checks
  • Maintain accurate records for compliance with clinical guidelines and regulatory requirements
  • Assist with patient outreach to support adherence to treatment plans or follow-up appointments
  • Manage prescription refills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Registered RN – Required
  • DC License – Required or within 90 days if active current state license
  • BSN, MSN or MHSA, MPH or equivalent – Preferred
  • Certified in clinical specialty – Preferred
  • 2+ years experience in an academic health system - Preferred
  • 3+ years ambulatory nursing experience or 2 years inpatient experience on a med/surg unit - Required

Core Competencies

  • Patient-centered care and cultural sensitivity
  • Clinical judgment and escalation awareness
  • Effective communication with multidisciplinary teams
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced setting
  • Attention to detail and commitment to clinical excellence

Work Environment

  • Ambulatory clinical setting with a balance of patient-facing and administrative duties
  • May require sitting, standing, and moving between care areas throughout the day
  • Requires indirect supervision of non-licensed staff and/or medical assistants

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $95,000 to $100,000

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Health Care Provider

Industries

  • Online Audio and Video Media

title: Billing Analyst I
description:
About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally. We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally. We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people. We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

It is a hybrid schedule (3 days at the office per week) in Rio de Janeiro - Cinelândia.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

Principle Accountabilities

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amounts that are not billed timely or become aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Deliver pro forma invoicing, pre-approvals, SES, etc.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and in a timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48-hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIS.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Fluent English.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • 1+ years of experience in a finance function (billing experience preferred, but not required).
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.
  • Focused and dedicated mindset.
  • Good team player with the ability to drive changes and improvements.
  • Knowledge of funding and non-funding.
  • Knowledge of withholding tax (training provided).

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Our Core Values

  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

title: Manager, Overlay Cluster FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The Overlay Cluster Manager plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure across a group of assigned venues. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards.

  1. Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
  2. Implement change management processes and maintain budget control for venues under your responsibility. Organize, coordinate, and oversee the flow of technical information (e.g., drawings, requirements, updates) across all venues in the cluster.
  3. Maintain clear communication with stadium authorities to ensure alignment on timelines, by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  4. Work closely with overlay delivery partners from planning through construction and removal, monitoring the execution of the project scope to ensure all requirements are met and that spaces are handed over on time and to the expected quality throughout all project phases, including reinstatement.
  5. Provide regular updates on overlay progress at assigned venues, track project milestones and deliverables, and support timely resolution of issues or delays.
  6. Support operational design development by transforming raw data into accurate base CAD drawings, integrating operational, overlay, and legacy content, and ensuring all updates adhere to FIFA standards and templates. Delivering complete and timely drawing sets aligned with project schedules and inspection requirements.
  7. Align and establish a clear and consistent code/naming convention for commodities to be integrated into the design, enabling effective status tracking and change management control.

Your profile

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years or more in infrastructural projects or Overlay/Technical Service roles in Major Events for a Sporting Organization.
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure.
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Autodesk applications (AutoCAD, Revit, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.)
  • Proficient in MS Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Availability to travel as needed

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Job description for Offshore Planner position

Reports To: Offshore Maintenance Superintendent (hierarchically)
Onshore Planning Lead (functionally)


Background: This position will be responsible for the look ahead and ensuring that all planned and corrective maintenance is effectively scheduled to meet requirements considering the activities in the asset plan and associated vendor requirements. They are the owner of 14 and 28 days look ahead.
Accountable For: Typical Responsibilities & Standards

1) Develop And Maintain Effective Working Relationships
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and visitors to the working environment.
Establish and maintain effective communications with colleagues, external visitors and supervisors.
Carry out accurate and effective work handovers.
2) Implementation of Management System
Ensure compliance with applicable IOP planning and CMMS procedure.
Liaise, prepare and update Unit weekly planning and scheduling activities.
Conduct weekly Planning meetings with offshore HOD’s and onshore IOP planner to freeze 14 days look ahead schedule.
Ensure any conflict in respect to SIMOPS, resources and materials are highlighted to the relevant parties.
Ensure in conjunction with all HOD’s that all assurance activities are carried out on the schedule and comply with unit’s verification scheme.
Responsible for reviewing & prioritizing all corrective work requests with the work team to ensure corrective work order priorities are properly assigned.
3) Control of Works
Offshore owner of 14 and 28 days plan lookahead, ensuring that all planned and corrective maintenance is effectively scheduled to meet requirements considering the activities in the asset plan and associated vendor requirements.
Monitor weekly execution progress
When required develop work plans for maintenance jobs with necessary information to allow efficient scheduling, assignment, and execution of maintenance work.
Perform site readiness check and validate the appropriate job work scope with the offshore disciplines and feedback to onshore unit planner.
Monitor Maintenance KPIs and performances, warn support team of any recurring problems related to the maintenance activity back log.
Suggests improvements and requests modifications for planning and for the CMMS and Work Order flow chart.
4) Management of Conditions, Behaviours and Events
Contribute to the continued improvement and implementation of the best practices in the planning discipline.
Review CMMS reporting are done efficiently and correctly. Equally, help with CMMS activities such as correction of Notifications, upload activities report under CMMS, and so on.

Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience
Degree in relevant technical or business discipline or can be substituted by suitable industry experience.
Extensive experience as a maintenance planner or Supervisor in oil and gas upstream industries.
A basic knowledge of the process of oil and gas treatment, installations and a thorough knowledge of the equipment used in oil and gas treatment installations.
Experience in Planning software (primavera P6) and CMMS (IFS) and electronic Permit-to-Work systems.
Proficiency in English at a minimum of B1 level according to the CEFR international standard.
